Name: Magical Circus of Hus
Text: The Magical Circus of Hus arrived at your realm. They do not look to be living beings with those kinds of faces, so you allow them to settle down.

Name: Princess's Request
Text: The Princess Doll, your daughter, came pleading to allow her to join in the war. You could not let your precious daughter come to harm; there must be a way to please her somehow.

Name: Chaotic Time
Text: A time of change, a time of love. There was peace but chaos always come.

Name: Priority of Love and War
Text: It had been some times since the two of you met. Love bloomed but wars were more important.

Name: Rift in Love
Text: Love life was never easy in these times. Rifts were as common as deaths.

Name: Love Victorious
Text: Reconciliation, no amount of rift could deny fate.

Name: Life Purpose
Text: Joyous news, offspring to be expected. The fruits of love.

Name: New Beginning
Text: Came twin heirs of the realm, Bersa and Sintor.

Name: Monnirl Joined!
Text: Your dedication to the faith impressed the Practical Monnirl. She resolved to join your crusade to embolden the true religion.

Name: Champion Joined!
Text: Pitied at the sorry state of your realm, the Royal Champion joined your side.

Name: Vurus Joined!
Text: Vurus, the great strategist, believed your rule is certainly with great merit. He wanted to ensure that the world belongs to the rightful ruler.

Name: Adaqua Joined!
Text: Defeating the Red Leaf gang left Adaqua without purpose. She instead offered her service to you.

Name: Yuawies Joined!
Text: Lured by the foods and festivities, Yuawies the Dryad appeared for the feast and became attracted to your culture.

Name: Kak Joined!
Text: The majestic Kak the Hornmonkey arrived at your domain. Rabbitmen became enamoured with his horn playing and invited him to join and play at the enemies.

Name: Nalana Joined!
Text: The flower gardens in your realm were pretty nice. Said Nalana, who appeared out of nowhere and decided to become their protector.

Name: Olsilin Joined!
Text: You managed to attract the most troublesome pixie. She liked your water springs and refused to leave.

Name: Vasla Joined!
Text: Some rabbitmen became friends with Vasla. He decided to come out of seclusion and joined your cause.

Name: Nadvalin Joined!
Text: A very mysterious girl carrying a tree approached a warren and proclaimed, "You are all my friends now!". What happened next surprises no one.

Name: King Doll Joined!
Text: The prince has proven himself capable. With your realm stabilised and automated, you can now directly participate in the wars you will commit.

Name: Toy Wagon Joined!
Text: The Joyride band returned from their world-round journey. To repay the travelling funds you provided, they joined your war.

Name: Hus Joined!
Text: The cheering sound resonated through the theatre hall: HUS! HUS! HUS! And the new age of entertainment arrived.

Name: Verlindas Joined!
Text: The Magical Circus of Hus became one of the cornerstones of your realm. The dolls love the Circus. And so to keep them entertained, Verlindas entered the fray.

Name: Taladamun Joined!
Text: Civilisations cannot exist without entertainment. Taladamun promised to bring joy to all with the ultimate magical act.

Name: Noxbox 201 Joined!
Text: The service bot, Noxbox 201, discovered the legendary magical wand in an abandoned storage. You decided to put its newfound power to better use.

Name: Amgarn Joined!
Text: Amgarn the Black Cat arrived at your realm. His great swordsmanship attracted your interest, and you decided to hire him.

Name: Amunsa Joined!
Text: Amunsa the Blacksmith arrived at your realm. His thirst for revenge drove him to battle, and you thought he could be of use.

Name: Dashisi Joined!
Text: Dashisi the Fairy arrived at your realm. He told you he can make a lot of heads you do not like roll, so you hired him.

Name: Elmaliern Joined!
Text: Elmaliern the Widow arrived at your realm. She did not look capable of battle, but something about her was interesting enough that you let her stay.

Name: Eona Joined!
Text: Eona the Blind Songstress arrived at your realm. She wished to stop all wars with her song. But since she could not see, you came up with an idea.

Name: Nraesier Joined!
Text: Nraesier the Scout arrived at your realm. Her dubious over-promise caused you to hesitate in hiring her. She just stayed around anyway.

Name: Vraesier Joined!
Text: Vraesier the Vagrant Warrior arrived at your realm. Her mighty power would be of great use, so you hired her on the spot.
